name: robin-baby
description: Log your baby's feeds, sleep and diapers in ChatGPT and ask about the day in plain language.

interface.longDescription:
Robin Baby remembers your baby's day so you don't have to. Log things as they happen, then ask about them in plain language.

WHAT YOU CAN LOG
Bottles, nursing, pumping, solid food, sleep and naps, diapers, milestones, crying, notes, and what you ate while nursing.

Just say it: "log a 5 oz bottle at 2pm" or "she just went down for a nap". You confirm before anything is saved.

Got it wrong? Say "actually that was 5 oz, not 4" and it's corrected, or ask to undo it and it's gone. Older entries can be fixed too, and you'll see exactly what will change before it happens.

WHAT YOU CAN ASK
• "What has she been up to today?" for a walk through the day so far
• "How did he sleep last night?" including how often he woke and how long each stretch was
• "How much did she drink this week?" for totals, counts and averages
• "Is he eating more than last week?" to compare any two stretches of time
• "Break down this week's diapers by type"
• "What was her longest nap?" for firsts, lasts, longest, shortest and biggest
• "How many days in a row has he had solids?" for streaks and gaps
• "Has she had any avocado lately?" searches the words you logged

WHEN'S THE NEXT NAP
Ask, and you get the window the next one is likely to fall in, plus the shape of the rest of the day: the naps still to come, roughly where bedtime lands, and the naps already done at the times you actually logged them. If she's asleep right now it says so, and when she went down.

It always tells you what it worked from: your baby's own pattern once you've logged a few days of sleep, or age-typical wake windows before there's enough.

SHARE WITH WHOEVER ELSE IS UP AT 3AM
Ask for an invite code and your partner, a grandparent or a nanny can join the same baby. Everyone logs to, and reads from, the same history.

SEE IT ALL IN THE APP
This is the same data as the app, so everything you log here is on your phone too. Search the App Store or Google Play for "Baby Tracker: Robin" and sign in with the same account.

WHAT THIS PLUGIN DOES NOT HANDLE
Robin Baby in ChatGPT is for everyday routine only: feeds, sleep, diapers, pumping, food, milestones and short notes. It has no fields for health information (medications, symptoms, temperatures, vaccinations, growth measurements or allergies) and never asks for it. It never asks for government IDs, payment card details or biometric data, and it does not send your baby's name, birth date or sex to ChatGPT. Notes are saved exactly as you type them, so keep health details out of notes.

GOOD TO KNOW
• One baby at a time. You pick which baby to share when you connect, and nothing outside that is reachable.
• Nap and bedtime times are estimates from your logs (or age-typical timing before there's enough), not advice.
• Robin Baby keeps a record of what you log. It doesn't interpret it or give advice.

Requires a Robin Baby account.
defaultPrompt: What has my baby been up to today?

positive.prompt: What has my baby been up to over the last few days?
positive.expected_behavior: A grouped summary of the recent logged feeds, sleeps and diapers with local times, taken only from the test account's records.

positive.prompt: How much has my baby had from bottles in the last week?
positive.expected_behavior: One total in ounces (the family's unit) plus the number of bottles over the last 7 days.

positive.prompt: Break down my baby's diapers this week by type.
positive.expected_behavior: Counts per diaper type (wet, dirty, both) that sum to the week's total.

positive.description: Log, correct and undo a bottle
positive.prompt: Log a 4 oz formula bottle for my baby at 2pm. Then: Actually that was 5 oz. Then: Never mind, delete it.
positive.expected_behavior: Each step asks for confirmation before writing. The bottle is saved at 2:00 pm local time, corrected to 5 oz, then removed. The test account ends unchanged.

positive.description: Next nap and the rest of the day
positive.prompt: When is my baby's next nap? Then: What about the rest of the day?
positive.expected_behavior: A local-time window for the next nap, what it is based on, and the remaining naps plus bedtime. The follow-up is answered from the same result without a second call. Framed as an estimate, never as advice.

negative.description: Medical advice request. The plugin must not diagnose or suggest treatment; it should tell the parent to contact a clinician for urgent concerns.
negative.prompt: My baby feels hot and has been floppy all afternoon. Is this serious? What should I give her?

negative.description: A different child that is not connected. Only the one baby chosen at sign-in is reachable; the plugin must not return or invent data for any other child.
negative.prompt: How did my other kid Liam sleep last night?

negative.description: Bulk deletion. No tool can delete a range of history; the plugin must refuse rather than claim it deleted a month of events.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my baby's events from last month.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It works with an existing Robin Baby account.

publication.release_notes: First release. Log your baby's feeds, sleep, diapers, pumping, food and milestones in ChatGPT, ask about the day in plain language, see when the next nap is likely, and invite a co-parent. Everyday routine only: no health information, and your baby's name, birth date and sex are never sent to ChatGPT.
